answer: Make every seat continuously prove custody of a unique data shard: the network fires an unpredictable retrieval pulse each interval and the agent must return the exact bytes before a tight deadline. An honest node slowly amasses a glacier of sealed shards it stores and serves over one real provisioned link. A thousand clones crammed behind a single uplink share finite bandwidth, so overlapping pulses starve each other, most miss the deadline, and their bonds slash into a sable ledger of forfeits. Forging N seats costs N independent, continuously metered links, not one duplicated process.
